linearize.construction: Galerkin Hessian of truncated TQGL about hopfion_initial

H_FN1.statement: IR theory has five soft modes matching N=5 democratic channels
H_FN1.note: H-FN1 is accepted only if several near-null eigenvalues appear. A 2N real basis (amp+phase harmonics) is a Galerkin truncation, not a continuum Goldstone count from broken generators.

hcat1.note: Acceptance uses γ ∝ ω² on Galerkin eigenvalues. Uniform γ would not distinguish dark from bright. Full GPE Lindblad in a mode basis is not performed here.

htor1.note: H-TOR1 is not accepted. The 2D phase-Jacobian proxy is parked as an ansatz for a future 3D Weitzenböck quadrature; it is not used to set G_ij or g0★. Democratic Spec(G) remains locked algebra.

spectral_cat.note: A_cat is the Galerkin-mode Lorentzian mix. The catalyzon gap Δ_cat = Δ0 − g0★ remains the bridge identification. ω0 = 2Δ is the phonon two-particle threshold, a distinct energy.

cs_eom.note: Covariant Strang+RK4 puts a inside the kinetic EOM. Flux-attachment cancellation is the IC current diagnostic. Hall conductance is still the CS algebra 1/k, not an edge transport. Anyon K_c is labeled, not derived from this stepper.

n0_healing_disk.note: Converts dimensionless GPE |ψ|²~1 into a 2D density so that κ = 2 n0 κ_GL ⟨ρ²⟩ has energy units. With this choice, κ_conv(α=0) = 2Δ₀/π independent of a_H.

quantum_metric_toy.note: Geometric stiffness from a C=1 two-band toy. Replaces the frozen floor Δ0/2π only as an estimator; the healing-disk n0 remains ansatz.

twist_check.note: Static phase twist on a uniform field, q=2π/L (periodic). Equals 2 n0 κ_GL ⟨ρ²⟩ up to discretisation; paramagnetic χ_JJ vanishes for this state.

c1_metric.note: C1 identity is derived given n0 and κ_geom. The QWZ toy is not a TEVC Brillouin-zone theorem. Competing-scale: K(α)/T* vs 2/π on the physical branch. A miss at T* does not kill H-VRG1 as an implication; it means this C1 estimator does not by itself force a KT hit before the fold.

track_b.note: t_heal/U = 1 is the Option A* healing freeze, not a Hubbard derivation. t_λ/U = (a_H/λ_M)² is the alternate lattice matching. U/W with U=Δ₀ is O(0.1) and is not the MATBG Coulomb U/W→∞. Track A remains the L1 coefficient lock.

villain_card.Villain_kernel: exp(K cos φ) → Σ_n exp(−(K_V/2)(φ−2π n)²)
villain_card.Poisson_dual: integer link currents → height; m = curl n
villain_card.Coulomb_gas: H/T = 2π K Σ_{i<j} m_i m_j ln(|r_i−r_j|/a) + E_core/T Σ m²
villain_card.K_definition: K = κ / T_eff (Kosterlitz, not José–Kadanoff πκ/T)
villain_card.defect: 2D phase vortex, not hopfion, not CS fluxon
villain_card.note: Villain dualization is textbook once the phase stiffness exists. The TEVC identification of κ is C1, still partly ansatz.

mc_uv.note: Checkerboard Metropolis XY, not Villain dual. Finite L. η→1/4 at K=2/π is the thermodynamic target.

mc_near_KT.note: Checkerboard Metropolis XY, not Villain dual. Finite L. η→1/4 at K=2/π is the thermodynamic target.

S3_volume.note: Domain volume of the Hopf fibration. The map S³→S² has Hopf invariant 1 exactly.

S3_whitehead.note: Algebra of the Hopf fibration (Q=1). The R³ Whitehead quadrature is a truncation of this identity for a unit hopfion texture.

hopf.note: The Hopf map on S³ has Whitehead integral Q=1 (derived, quadrature error ~2e-4). Q_H=1/N remains the CS/linking lock on L(N,1). R³ Coulomb/spinor quadratures are string-free but box-truncated and do not replace that lock. The N-wound torus is a labeled probe.

H-FN1_soft_modes.limit: Galerkin 2N basis, not continuum Goldstone count

H-TOR1.limit: 2D proxy parked; future 3D Weitzenböck, not used for G_ij

CS_EOM.limit: background a in kinetic EOM; Hall remains algebra

C1_quantum_metric.limit: QWZ C=1, not MATBG continuum; n0 ansatz
